reference_formalization: ∀ (a b c₀ c₁ : Point) (AB C : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c₀ c₁ C ∧ |(a─b)| > |(c₀─c₁)| → ∃ e : Point, between a e b ∧ |(a─e)| = |(c₀─c₁)|
nl_statement: For two given unequal straight-lines, to cut off from the greater a straight-line equal to the lesser. Let $AB$ and $C$ be the two given unequal straight-lines, of which let the greater be $AB$.  <prf> So $AE$ is also equal to $C$ [C.N.~1]. Thus, for two given unequal straight-lines, $AB$ and $C$, the (straight-line) $AE$, equal to the lesser $C$, has been cut off from the greater $AB$.
